We're inside Outer Heaven.
We should use this information to build a montage of the suspect, and then run it through Jordan to see if there are any matches.
You mean like building a composite photograph?
It would be nice if Isabella would come back to headquarters with us.
Well, I guess we'll just have to have her take a look at it later.
Thank you very much.
Let's see, um... that will be 10,000 credits.
What!! 10,000 credits!? Metal!
What is that funny smirk supposed to mean?
Uh, I forgot my wallet.
Really? I thought I just saw you with it.
Expenses. This is all just expenses for the investigation, right Metal?
I not so sure about that.
Okay, that's 10,000 exactly. Thank you.
Let's see, um... that will be 5,000 credits.
Yeah, Metal... you wanna get that please.
What? You're not actually planning on writing this off a business expenses are you?
Of course I am! You gotta problem with that?!
No... but if the Chief finds out about this...
Okay, that's 5,000 exactly. Thank you.
Let's see, um... that will be 2,000 credits.
Here you go... 2,000.
Okay, that's 2,000 exactly. Thank you.
Let's see, just the cover charge. That will be 500 credits.
500? Here you go... 500 credits.
Okay, that's 500 exactly. Thank you.
But we just arrived!
But we have not learned anything yet!
The other customers are all dressed up in various costumes. It appears to be show time now.
Who's the guy over behind the counter?
That's the manager from before.
That's the manager. You just met him, remember?
There don't seem to be any tables open. The place appears to be quite popular.
That's him! The monk hero who fought the secret group Shakkuri!
Oh yeah, that one. Mask Rider Black (Revenge of Kunta Kinte) - the TV show about a monk fighting racism.
That customer is dressed as Mask Rider, the mysterious monk hero.
Oh! This one's a character from The Stuffed Monkey, a movie that played at the British Museum.
Ah, I see. That's one of the three wise monkeys, isn't it... See no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil.
They stuffed the talking monkey to shut him up, and that's how the saying was born?
That customer is dressed as Kounerya, the space ape man.
This is the lonely Eiriyan. He's friendly, tries to stick his tongue in everyone's mouth, ages incredibly fast, and everybody hates him for being such a pervert.
Oh, that one! The movie about the interstellar marriage scam where he preyed on old maids, even though he had parents and siblings back in The Eiriyans... that gossip horror flick?
That's right. The song Eiriyan, I hear you finally got married, sigh... was a huge hit.
The tagline You won't find a spouse out in space was popular too.
It really predicted men's marriage troubles perfectly.
These days he's supposedly reformed and shaved his head bald.
That customer is dressed as Eiriyan.
This one is... that's right! The character Okane san, the arcade kid.
I know that one! The moving story of a boy who worked day and night making change just to play video games.
In the end he had so much spare change that he ended up becoming a coin changer at the arcade, what a twist...
In that movie he tried to switch the games over to a token system like they use in America, showing us a whole new direction for game centers.
That customer is dressed as Okane san.
Oh, this one! It's H2O, the translator robot from that All Star Wars series.
Of course I know it! A robot who dreams of stardom auditions for a musical.
But his joints were too stiff, so he got cut - he couldn't breakdance.
Next he tried using his talent for translation to become an interpreter on the music show Midnight Hot Plate.
But he got cut again, because he could never pass the Grade 2 English proficiency test.
That customer is dressed as H2O.
That's... Gulliver, the Anorexia Syndrome isn't it.
I saw that! That's the Hollywood movie directed by Steve Two and Carpet George, right?
It's a kung fu flick about a fight in a beauty salon over an anorexia suit that lets anyone lose weight without effort.
That customer is dressed as Gulliver.
It's just like a space bar in here. Mask Rider, Kounerya, Eiriyan, Okane san, H2O, and Gulliver too... everyone's really gotten into character.
The owner of this place has some old fashioned taste.
Gillian! What you staring at?
Wow. She really knows how to move her body!
I'd really like to talk to her again.
Savor the moment, Gillian! Her dancing is really something special!
I see. You weren't kidding, were you?
I'll call the manager over.
Hello, can I help you with something?
Oh, it's you.
Oh... do you need something else?
I'll call Isabella.
Hey! Isabella! Over here!
Oh, you two again? What can I do for you?
Hi there, boys! I'm Isabella Velvet. Is there something I can do for you?
A Junker and.... a robot?
An Easter Island statue and.... a robot?
A mummy and.....a robot?
I'll call Sparkster.
Yeah? What do you want?
I'll call Goemon.
Hey! Don't bother me! Whatcha want anyway...?
I'll call the Ueda character from Lethal Enforcers.
What's the matter?
I'll call the Contra guy.
You need something?
I'll call the Castlevania pair.
What? We haven't done nothing.
I'll call Gulliver.
Huh? Me?
Be reasonable, Gillian, or the Chief will get upset again.
But you just ate!
How about bringing us some of that buffalo?
Here you are.
Mmmm. Buffalo-ey. This.. This is great!
You are probably still suffering from the effects of your drink...
That's it! I've had it! No more drinking for me!
Bartender! Give me a Moonsalt, will ya'?
Bartender! How about another one of those Moonsalts?
Gillian! You're on duty!
Bartender! Another Moonsalt!
Whoa! I think all those drinks are starting to get to me...
Would you please stop this...
Maybe I'll take this mask off...
Excuse me, sir, but during Masquerade Hour you have to keep your mask on. If not, we'll have to ask you to leave.
All right, I'll leave it on.
Maybe I'll take this mask off...
I'm sorry, but it's the rules. You'll have to leave!
They haven't come to take our order...
Maybe you should tell that guy over there... He looks like the manager.
During Masquerade Hour, everybody has a mask or makeup on. It's impossible to tell who is who.
Other than us, the clientele here looks a little rough...
Hey! What are you doing?
Watch it! What's your problem?
Cut that out! What do you think you're doing?
The customer wasn't carrying anything suspicious.
Unfortunately, we couldn't learn anything.
Waiter! Seconds!
Waiter! Give me another order of this!
Here you are.
Mmmm. This is really good...
Please stop this Gillian.
Here you are.
<<gulp, gulp>> Ahhh! That really hits the spot!
Ah, Isabella! Sorry! I don't really have anything to say...
How rude...
You've been a tremendous help. Thank you very much.
I glad I could be. Now, if you'll excuse me...
Thank you very much. You've been quite helpful.
Really, well then if you'll excuse me...
Thanks, I think what you've told us may help a bit...
Okay, see you...
I'll be waiting for your call!
Oh my god...what a knockout! And that leather outfit...
What's wrong? Do you find me attractive?
Please don't stare at me like that. I'm shy and you're embarassing me.
You're a pretty good-looking guy.
Long face, nice tan...
(Uh, I'm wearing a mask...)
Passionate lips, fair-skinned...
(Uh, I'm wearing a mask...)
I wouldn't mind letting you take me out for dinner or something.
What about after dinner?
Well, that all depends on you...
Metal! Did you hear that?
Don't forget that we are in the middle of an investigation.
Just relax Metal... I'll buy you a cute little robot to play with later. So, Isabella, when would you like to go out?
What? Did you think I was serious? I was just kidding.
What? J..just kidding?
Come on...With that Easter Island mask, I can't even tell what you look like.
Come on...With that mummy mask, I can't even tell what you look like.
Well, it would appear that she really took you for a ride... <<SMASH>> Ouch!
That's about enough, right? Consider yourself lucky for being able to get such a close look at me...
Jeez... look at the size of those...eyes on her. Its amazing what 21st Century technology is capable of.
What's wrong, Gillian?
(Gotta love these actresses. Jamie looks like a little boy compared to this woman!)
Gillian, what are you mumbling about?
With a beauty like me right in front of you, you shouldn't be looking anywhere else, right?
Oh...sorry.
Hey! Just where do you think you're looking?
I'll investigate her!
No, I think it's best if I handle it...
I can manage by myself...
What's wrong? Aren't you going to investigate me?
No, that's all right.
It would probably take too long to check these, er, you out.
Such bad jokes...
Give it a rest, will you?
You're so persistent!
Isabella, would you mind giving me your phone number?
No way...
I'm afraid I can't tell you.
No, I really shouldn't.
Give it up.
Oh, okay. You win. All right, listen carefully. I'm only going to tell you once. It's 39-6004. When you call, make it in the afternoon, okay?
Yes! Excellent! Heh, heh, heh...
What is that snicker supposed to mean?
Well, it was just the other day. It wasn't Masquerade Hour, so I remember his face pretty clearly.
He seemed to be waiting around for one of our regular customers.
A regular?
He was going out of his way to eat buffalo...then he spat up blood. I was really grossed out!
You say he was waiting for someone?
Well, I suppose it was more like he was following him. He left as soon as the other guy did.
I haven't seen him since then.
Can I look at the photo again?
I don't know who you're talking about. Do you have a picture or something?
A picture?
Yes, a picture. You have a photo of Jean, right?
There is a photo of Jean at his home.
At Gibson's place, eh..?
He was in here at all different times, so he probably doesn't have a job, or work regular hours.
I've only been here for a month, so I don't know anything about what happened before that.
Could you try to remember his distinguishing characteristics?
Gillian, keep the description in mind. Afterwards, we can use it to put together a montage.
It figures that Mr. Ueda didn't know what he was talking about.
What was the overall shape of his face?
He had kind of a bony look.
What about his eyes?
He had this really piercing gaze... a rather threatening look.
What kind of nose did he have.
It was pointy, like mine.
How about his mouth?
He had thin lips, I think.
How was he wearing his hair?
It was sort of naturally flowing, towards the back of this head.
And he had a big widow's peak.
About how old would you say he was?
He looked like he was in his thirties.
Thanks very much. You've been quite helpful.
I hope you can use this information.
Would you mind telling me a little about him?
The manager said you would know a lot about him.
Well, I don't know a lot, but maybe I can help...
I don't know his name, but he was in here all the time. Especially when we weren't running Masquerade Hour.
Outside of Masquerade Hour? So that means you've seen his face, then. Do you remember it?
...I think so.
All right, Metal. Let's have her come down to headquarters with us. We need to use Jordan and put together a montage.
We can't take her to headquarters.
Why not?
Well, it's like the manager said. She's a star actress.
If the media were to find out about this, we'd never get any cooperation ever again.
Since she is a famous star, if the media gets hold of the story and starts a fuss, it will impede our investigation.
If the SNATCHERS were to learn what we're up to...
What are you mumbling about?
This is really a delicate issue...
Although inconvenient, we should take down her description, and then go back to headquarters to build the montage on our own.
That's right. You know, I have a new holographic movie that starts shooting next month, and I have to start studying my lines, so...
And I've got a virtual reality job coming up, too...
And a couple of offers for some TV soaps...
You're quite busy, aren't you?
I won't be able to dance again here for some time.
What kind of men do you like?
Let's see... somebody really masculine who you can depend on. You know, the kind of guy who grabs you and says "Come on baby, follow me".
Somebody with well-formed opinions. But I hate guys who aren't flexible.
Well, that about rules you out, Gillian!
You shut up!
What about career preferences?
Well, investigators are really strong and masculine types.
I was always a big fan of crime dramas when I was little.
Still, it really doesn't matter as long as you like the guy.
Um, uh... could I have your autograph?
My autograph? Well let's see... I don't have anything to write with.. Oh, how about this... <<smooch!>>
Whoa!
Ah! I saw that! I'm telling Jamie!
Isabella... look into my eyes. Open your heart...
Oh god... what kind of a line is that supposed to be?
Um... Isabella, you know I've always cared deeply for you...
Spare me your tacky come-ons, okay?
I'm into much younger guys than you, anyway.
You know, I have to be careful when I say this, but I'm a Junker. How about a date?
I hate Junkers.
You guys never trust anybody, right?
I don't want anything to do with men who can't trust people.
If that's true, than I have nothing else to say to you.
I wouldn't want you to start questioning me while we were in the middle of a date.
Come on baby, follow me!
Oh you are a simple one... That was just an example!
Where are you going to take me? It has to be really exciting place, or I'll leave.
Exciting? Hmmm. What kind of place would that be?
Oh dear. I can see I'd be wasting my time...
What time do you get off work today?
Are you trying to invite me somewhere? You have to come on stronger than that.
Would you like to go out with me, Isabella?
I'm just not excited by those run-of-the-mill come-ons...
So a kiss just isn't good enough for you, huh?
Well, that makes two women who have dumped you.
Was there some problem with my approach?
No. The problem is you.
Well, you know they say that many women are uncomfortable around particularly handsome men...
Whatever you say, Gillian.
What?!
I don't use that stuff. I have an anti-ultraviolet coating applied directly to my skin.
Don't you just hate the strong ultraviolet in the summer?
Oh yes, I remember him. This is the guy who got sick after eating buffalo.
This guy? I might have met him somewhere... No, I can't remember.
She seems like she might be able to remember.
Take a careful look, okay?
Hmmm. Oh! That's right!
This was the guy who got sick after eating buffalo. I remember him.
Hmmm. I think that's what he looked like...
Oh yes. That's him. No mistake...
This is why I really hate government employees...
We don't really need to conduct an investigation do we, Metal?
Well, I guess you're right.
Metal. Stop that vulgar nonsense. You have to learn to be more mature.
What? Have I done something wrong?
So you do like this!
What are you talking about! Look at yourself!
Be careful or you'll have the Chief angry at you again.
Is that a threat?
Call it a promise.
You are such an annoying little yutz.
I think that's enough...that was a special exception, you know.
Oh, come on!
Men are never satisfied...they always want more.
That's it. No second time. You understand me? No second time.
You're going to hurt yourself if you try much harder.
Sorry. No idea.
What? I really don't know?
(Jeez... One minute it's "Don't stare like that," the next it's "Don't let your eyes wander". Make up your mind, woman!)
Thank you very much. You've been quite helpful.
Thanks. Sorry to bother you.
This isn't working. It doesn't appear that we'll be able to get anything worthwhile.
What's the deal with this guy?
Yukkk! This guy has got a pretty ugly mug!
What're you talkin' about?
What's with this?
You want a great tip?
This guy.. he gets into a fight with another guy... gets hit hard with this steel pipe, you know. Doesn't even flinch, man.
No way he's human, man.
You be careful, man.
Can you recall what he looked like for me?
What was the general shape of his face?
A big circle, man. Really round.
How about his eyes?
He had two.
What kind of nose did he have.
Two nostrils.
What was his mouth like?
Square, man.
How was he wearing his hair?
Bald as a cue ball, man.
About how old would you say he was?
Definitely older or younger than you, man.
Thanks a lot. You've been helpful.
That couldn't be the same man that Isabella described, could it?
He was spouting garbage. Don't even worry about it.
Do you think his testimony was accurate?
Get real, Metal. He was just trying to yank our chain.
Should we ask about the man that Isabella was talking about?
Should we ask about the man that Isabella described?
I don't want anything pushed on me, man.
I don't understand that hard stuff.
Hey, who knows, man?
Huh?
I know that guy! I talked to him. I hate guys like that...always asking a lot of questions about people...
I haven't seen him around lately.
I don't really remember what he looked like.
I don't remember what he looked like at all.
I've seen this guy before.
Nah. Never seen him.
I don't know...
I no unnerstan whuh you talk bout.
Leave me alone!
Just leave me be...
Oh! A movie actor?
Scary-lookin' feller. Who is he?
Nope. I dunno him.
Nope. Ain't never seen 'em.
Hey, I'm really sorry about that. Don't worry about it.
Oh really...
Thanks for your help, sir. You've been very cooperative.
Oh really? Well, take your time...enjoy yourself.
Well thanks. You've helped a bit.
...enjoy yourself!
That's one of the characters from "Cosmik Debris"!
Well, you really know your stuff, don't you?
Well, I guess...
....yeah.
What's wrong, Gillian?
No, it's nothing.
...Ah, I got it!
What's wrong, Gillian?
I've been trying to figure out what this reminds me of, and I just got it.
What does it remind you of?
Yeah, it's like a little... no, I can't really say.
It's really made well.
Would you mind if I check this out?
What? Are you one of those types?
Do you mind? That's really disturbing.
He seems to be built quite well.
There is nothing out of the ordinary.
Oh, this guy? He's the one who got sick.
He seemed real old-fashioned. I think that was the first time he was here.
Sorry. My memory's not that good at details.
Sorry, I really don't know. In this business you meet so many people, I can't remember all of 'em you know.
Sorry. I really don't know.
You never can tell, but Isabella might know something.
I'm afraid I don't know who that is...do you have a photograph?
She'll be dancing here through the end of the month. Look, she's at it right now. She's between pictures at the moment, so we had her come dance for us.
She's one of the top in the business right now. We're the only club that she'll dance at, you know.
She danced for a while here long before she got famous, you know. That's why she comes back every now and then.
I've known her since she was a lot younger, but she's hardly changed. She's a good kid.
Yeah, I just talked to her. My pulse rate still hasn't returned to normal.
I hear you were a little pushy with Isabella...
Huh?
We can't have any of that, you know. This isn't some hostess bar.
Heh, heh, heh!
Thank you very much. You enjoyed the buffalo, didn't you? It's really good stuff...
But, keep it to yourself, okay. They're pretty strict on the enforcement of those buffalo hunting regulations.
I'm impressed. Not many of our customers put away that much food.
Well, he had a little too much to eat.
Would you care to try some? It's really a unique flavor.
This gentlemen? Let's see, yes... He's been coming regularly for about three months now.

He would always just sit there drinking Moonsalts, never ordering anything to eat and staring at the other customers. We're little more than a typical nightclub, but we get quite a few politicians, doctors, authors, and the like in here. Customers like that fellow are quite a nuisance you know...
So masquerade time is a big hit with customers like that, right?
That's right. And that particular gentleman only came outside of Masquerade Hour. And you know, there was even this strange rumor going around that he was a SNATCHER.
Come to think of it, I haven't seen him in a while. I wonder what happened to him?
I think Isabella probably knows more about him than I do.
Since I always have this on...
I really couldn't see too clearly the details of his appearance, you know.
Huh?!
Why yes, I believe that's what he looked like.
Yes, this is the man. No mistake.
Who is this? I'm afraid I don't know him. You see, nearly half of our operating hours is Masquerade Hour, so I wouldn't know if he was here or not.
Isabella may know. She's the closest to the customers, you see.
Who is that? A criminal or something?
What's that?
I'm sorry I can't help you more.
This place is using a transmitter to emit a signal which jams searches from government surveillance satellites.
Boy, they're really take precautions, don't they.
Well, these days it's hard to get customers in a place which doesn't block the scans.
The public's resistance to the government's attempts to completely control and manage information, eh?
The videophone cannot be used here.
Videophone signals are blocked by interference at this location.
We'll be thrown out again, Why don't you give it up?
You never learn do you? You're practically asking to be thrown out.
That's your Junker ID. It gives you all your special privileges. Take good care of it.
That's the expense money that the agency gave you.
That's the memo in which Gibson told you the whereabouts of the computer data explaining about the SNATCHER'S weak point.
I wonder what "Search the house!" means?
That's the key to Gibson's desk.
It's an exceptionally old antique.
That's the chess piece that Gibson had.
It's the chess piece that we found in Gibson's coat.
That's the floppy which contains data on the SNATCHER'S weak point.
That's a floppy disk for a personal computer.
That's the sunscreen that the SNATCHERS are using...if Gibson's theory is right.
And we've found out what we needed at Plato's Cavern.
It's ordinary sunscreen. There's a sticker with the logo of the store where it was purchased on it.
That's the mask that you bought at Plato's Cavern.
That's an Easter Island statue mask.
That's a mummy mask.
That's a picture of Jean Jack Gibson.
That's the montage that we built using witnesses' testimony.
It has an IC chip built-in which contains all of your personal data.
In principle, you are allowed to charge the Agency for as much money as is necessary for your investigation.
That's the memo that Jean left.
It's written on ordinary paper. It's definitely in Jean's handwriting.
That's the key to Gibson's desk in the Detective's Room.
What could this key be? I don't believe there are still any places which use keys like that.
That's a wooden chess piece. I believe it's the one which goes next to the King.
That's a wooden chess piece.
That's the disk with Gibson's notes in it.
That's a 5-inch floppy disk.
On the bottle it says "The store with everything: Plato's Cavern".
It definitely looks like it was being sold at Plato's Cavern.
We might learn something if we check out the place this was bought.
It's a special, high-detail mask, hand-crafted by the popular Rick Bakery.
That's a picture of Jean Jack Gibson.
That's a composite, 2-D photograph assembled from Jordan's 3-D data.
It was taken from the chess set at Jean's home. What could it mean?
Jean really liked puzzles.
This must have some secret meaning.
Jeez, this really looks like Ivan.
You have to be impressed by Alpha-One's search capabilities.
The house? Come to think of it, I don't have a house to come home to.
Do not get so depressed, Gillian. You'll be able to live with Jamie again sometime.
A home and family, eh? Those may not go along too well with being a Junker.
There's still some left, right?
There is considerably less since you gorged yourself.
Did I have that much? Wasn't it you?
What are you saying! I do not eat to excess!
C'mon, you've got to learn how to cover for you partner.
You've got to learn that my job is reporting on my partner.
Wait a minute? Are you transmitting this conversation to the Chief?
Hmmm. Maybe I am, maybe I'm not...
(Why this little piece of...)
You can't keep repeating the same mistakes, Gillian.
Well, you know human nature...
Gillian, don't ever show that thing around here, all right?
I know, I know... It's an undercover investigation.
No matter what, do you understand? You can't be so reckless.
All right, I'll save everything that has happened up until now.
Which file number would you like to save it in?
This file contains data from a previous save.
Is it okay for me to overwrite it with the new data?
In that case, I won't write the new data there.
You're already wearing it.
Oops! You're right!
